name: Dzhonni Holub
source:
Get ready to immerse yourself in the brutal and ruthless world of the Wild West, where no one can afford to click their beak. The brave hero of our history is Johnny the Pigeon.

The little nest where Johnny lived was once famous for its steadfast justice and laws. But someone appeared who decided to question the peaceful life of our young hero Johnny the Pigeon.

Can Johnny the Pigeon fight back? Will he have to leave his hometown forever? Watch only with us, specially for Ukrainian Visual Novel Jam #3

[Translated from [url=https://squidsquadpapi.itch.io/johnny-the-pigeon]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
準備好投身殘酷無情的狂野西部吧，在這裡，誰都不能掉以輕心。我們故事中的勇敢英雄，就是鴿子約翰尼。

約翰尼生活的小巢，曾以堅定維護正義與法律聞名。然而，有人出現了，決定挑戰年輕英雄鴿子約翰尼的平靜生活。

鴿子約翰尼能反擊嗎？他是否必須永遠離開家鄉？歡迎在第三屆烏克蘭視覺小說創作活動中，獨家見證！

[譯自[url=https://squidsquadpapi.itch.io/johnny-the-pigeon]Itch.io[/url]]
